title: A crash can make a delegation reuse a review submission attempt number whose result slot is already taken
outcome: A review submission attempt number is never reused across a crash: an attempt whose result was durably appended to the mailbox is discovered at boot (or before the next rearm), and a new attempt gets a number whose idempotency slot is free.
acceptance: A regression with the write-behind persistence worker connected: attempt N+1 is rearmed and its result durably appended, the host crashes before the rearm reaches disk, and the next follow-up gets an attempt number other than N+1 (or the orphaned N+1 result is reconciled), so its own result can be published.
No result of a new attempt is answered with an earlier attempt's accepted result.
